label: Expo (React Native)
buildGate: npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/ExpoBenchmark.xcworkspace -scheme ExpoBenchmark -configuration Debug -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" build
releaseBuildGate: npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/ExpoBenchmark.xcworkspace -scheme ExpoBenchmark -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" build
deviceBuildGate: npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/ExpoBenchmark.xcworkspace -scheme ExpoBenchmark -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath "$TE_ARCHIVE" -derivedDataPath "$TE_DERIVED" archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=''

notes.workspaceName: ios/ExpoBenchmark.xcworkspace and scheme ExpoBenchmark are produced by `expo prebuild` from app.json's `name`; the baseline scaffold pins name=ExpoBenchmark so this locator stays valid.
notes.cng: ios/ is generated, not committed — native configuration must go through app.json / config plugins, which is why those paths classify as native-config.
notes.mcpTier: Remote tier only. The local tier (expo-mcp package + EXPO_UNSTABLE_MCP_SERVER=1) stays off: simulator tap/screenshot would give this arm a visual verification loop no other arm has.
